thread:
Ana L: Kicking off a 2-week hybrid-ingest certification sprint. Goal: certify Snowflake + Databricks connectors and validate read/write flows to Qdrant/Milvus on Dedicated. Also do a minimal HW smoke on DGX nodes. Owners: infra, QE, partners comms.
Mike R: I can take infra. Plan: provision 2 DGX nodes in staging, k8s overlay, and a small S3 bucket with sample docs. ETA: tomorrow EOD.
Jordan P: I'll own QE/test matrix. Need concrete sample schemas (Snow VARIANT example + Delta table snapshot) and a list of edge cases (large payloads, nested JSON, upserts).
Lucy S: I'll handle partner comms & marketplace checklist. Will sync with partner PMs after we have test plan. Draft announcement checklist will include security review, listing assets, screenshots, and partner review slot.
Ana L: For Snowflake test data, here's a minimal VARIANT table snippet we can use:
```sql
CREATE TABLE ri_sample.variant_docs (id STRING, doc VARIANT);
INSERT INTO ri_sample.variant_docs VALUES ('a1', PARSE_JSON('{"text":"hello","meta":{"source":"s3"}}'));
```
Use that for schema compatibility tests.
Mike R: Putting together infra runbook. Two asks: (1) do we need Private deployment VPC peering for Snowflake connector end-to-end? (2) quantized model runner to verify token throughput on Dedicated?
Jordan P: Yes on VPC peering for the full e2e. For quant runner we only need a small 2-token per-request load to exercise KV cache; no heavy perf runs in this sprint.
Lucy S: Partner-facing timeline suggestion: Week1 = infra + sample data + smoke tests. Week2 = connector stress + marketplace docs + partner review. Agree? :thumbsup:
Ana L: Agree. Quick blockers: partner access to staging Snowflake account (creds + read/write role) and Databricks cluster creds. @Mike R can you request from Platform Ops?
Mike R: Request filed with Platform Ops (ticket #INC-4829). Also scheduling DGX provisioning now. EngOps Bot: DGX staging nodes allocated: dgx-01,dgx-02. Kubernetes overlay deployed to staging cluster.
QE Bot: Test harness blueprint uploaded to /repos/connector-tests/hybrid-sprint. Includes: integration.yml, sample datasets, and a smoke.sh script. Example invocation:
```bash
./smoke.sh --provider snowflake --table ri_sample.variant_docs --vector-db qdrant --batch 16
```
Jordan P: I'll kick off first smoke run tomorrow morning and paste logs here. Plan to capture failure modes: schema mismatch, partial writes, backpressure on vector DB.
Lucy S: I'll prep the partner sync invite for Thu 10am PT and attach the draft checklist. Can someone review the marketplace asset list before I send?
Ana L: I'll review marketplace assets. Jordan — once you have the smoke logs, drop the top 5 flaky tests so we can prioritize fixes.
Mike R: Noted. Any special compliance items? Security review needed for connector code that touches customer data. I'll ping Sec for a lightweight review slot.
Ana L: Thanks all — sprint kickoff done. Post updates here daily; tag @Ana L for escalations. :rocket:
